notes.subject: go thatafatša molala
notes.rationale: Sehlogo sa Seheberu sa 'go thatafatša sefapano/molala' se bolela go hana go theetša; Sepedi se boloka sebopego sa 'molala'.

notes.subject: go fa seatla
notes.rationale: 'תנו יד' — go inela, go itlhaganela; go ka fetwa bjalo ka 'la inelelang', fela sebopego sa seatla se bolokwa.

notes.subject: tukisho ya gafa gagwe
notes.rationale: חרון אף semologile go 'gafa e tukago' — 'אף' ke gafa/engo; 'maikutlo a mabe' ke phetolelo, e sego sebopego.

notes.subject: balaudi ba Yisraele
notes.rationale: Taello tše nne ka moka tša temana ye di tobetše go bona.

notes.subject: fanang ... le yeng ... le šome
notes.rationale: Letshwao la pele la go lalediša mmadi ka gare ga temana ka moka ya 30:5–9.

translation: Bjale le se ke la thatafatša melala ya lona bjalo ka bo-ntate lona; fanang seatla go Yahwe, gomme le yeng go lefelong la bokgethwa bja gagwe, ao a bo kgethilitšengo go lelekametšeng, gomme le šome ⟨את⟩ Yahwe, Elohim wa lona, gore tukisho ya gafa gagwe e fetošwe go tšwa go lona.
